scope: $T: equatable | ordered | numeric | copyable on procedure parameters, struct parameter lists and Pair($T: c) bindings; generic bodies are checked against the constraint; bindings outside it are refused at the use naming the declaration and constraint; a failing instance is traced to its first call with its bindings. Built-in names only, no operator overloading.

new_rules: PS_constraint: '$T: name' records the name in name2/loc2 on type_param nodes, in type positions and struct parameter lists
CK_Type.need: 0 none, 1 copyable, 2 equatable, 3 ordered, 4 numeric; each level allows the ones below
CK_need / CK_constrain: names (E0805 unknown or on a length), one constraint per parameter where it binds (E0808)
CK_numeric / CK_ordered / CK_meets: operators on placeholders follow the constraint; fixes name the constraint to add (E0309, E0310, E0311, E0326)
CK_coerce: an integer literal takes a numeric placeholder's type
CK_satisfies: a binding outside the template's constraint (E0806) at the call or instance type
CK_trace: an instance whose body fails reports E0807 at its first call with every binding

native_transport: src/errors.cpp: E0805-E0808 explanations; book appendix B regenerated

covers: max/sum/same/Range($T: ordered)/inside over int, f64, u8, string and an enum print 1121107 natively at -O0/-O2, under #run and coax test
refused at the declaration: < on unconstrained $T (E0310), + on ordered (E0309), == unconstrained (E0311)
refused at the call: max(true, false), same(P), R(bool) (E0806 naming the declaration and its line)
grow(u8) with x + 300: E0350 then the E0807 trace at the call
E0805 unknown names and lengths, E0808 a second constraint or one in a body

limits: constraint names are built in; no user-defined constraints or operator overloading
a procedure binding Range($T) repeats the struct's constraint
an instance's body is still checked per instance (E0807 when a literal does not fit)
seeds: bootstrap/parser.c, checker.c, checker.h regenerated; COAX_BUILD_FRESH=1 coax/build.sh bootstraps to a fixpoint

legacy_codegen.corpus: 1092 compilable repo sources outside coax/tests emit byte-identical C (compiler stamp aside); 182 do not compile standalone under the old compiler; 0 differ, 0 newly fail
